# rubrik_azure_kms_key_manager (Resource)

The `rubrik_azure_kms_key_manager` resource is used to register an Azure key
vault key manager in RSC.

A key manager is a stored connection profile giving RSC access to a customer
owned key management service. RSC takes the credentials from the cloud account,
so no credentials are stored. Its ID is the value archival locations refer to
the key manager by, alongside the name and version of the key itself, which come
from Azure.

-> **Note:** The Azure subscription must be onboarded to RSC with the
   `CLOUD_NATIVE_UEM_KEY_MANAGEMENT` feature, and the feature must be connected.

-> **Note:** RSC only supports updating the `name` and the `description`.
   Changing any other argument replaces the key manager. RSC refuses to delete a
   key manager which still encrypts an archival location.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Register an Azure key vault key manager for an Azure subscription onboarded
# with the CLOUD_NATIVE_UEM_KEY_MANAGEMENT feature.
resource "rubrik_azure_kms_key_manager" "production" {
  name             = "Production Azure Key Vault"
  description      = "Keys for the RCV archival locations."
  cloud_account_id = "f8c9c2a0-f02e-494d-bba9-0d4906917b8c"
  region           = "eastus2"
  vault_name       = "production-key-vault"
}

# The key manager ID is the value an RCV archival location refers to it by.
resource "rubrik_azure_rcv_archival_location" "archive" {
  name   = "eastus2-kms-archive"
  region = "eastus2"
  tier   = "BACKUP"

  key_vault_key {
    key_manager_id = rubrik_azure_kms_key_manager.production.id
    key_name       = "archive-key"
    key_version    = "56f46ba5741e4883b5e3ac5cb96a0a71"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_account_id` (String) RSC cloud account ID of the Azure subscription holding the key vault. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `name` (String) Key manager name. Key manager names are unique across all key managers.
- `region` (String) Azure region of the key vault, e.g. `eastus2`. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `vault_name` (String) Name of the key vault, not its URL. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Key manager description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) RSC key manager ID (UUID).
